prompt: Redis cluster configEpoch conflict same epoch which node increments
answer:
When two master nodes have the same `configEpoch`, the node with the **lexicographically smaller Node ID** increments its `currentEpoch` by 1 and assigns that value as its new `configEpoch`.

Thus, if multiple nodes collide, **all nodes except the one with the greatest Node ID** eventually move to new epochs. (Redis Cluster Specification; `clusterHandleConfigEpochCollision` in `src/cluster.c`.)
